name: KZEL Global Ventures
label: FROM BUSINESS IDEA TO DIGITAL PRESENCE
description: An export business, given a digital home. A focused website connecting Indian spices with international buyers.
overview: I wanted a credible digital presence for KZEL Global Ventures, my Indian spice export business. The website gives international buyers a clear route from exploring products to requesting a quotation.
contributions: Built product, company and director pages around the information a B2B buyer needs.
Added page metadata, a sitemap, canonical URLs and organization structured data.
Connected the site to Vercel and worked through Google Search Console verification.
note: The source repository includes the export website. Business outcomes and sales metrics are not claimed.

name: JARVIS
label: A PERSONAL EXPERIMENT IN VOICE AI
description: Exploring what a personal assistant can do when voice, desktop actions and memory come together.
overview: My JARVIS work explores a voice assistant on Windows: setting up speech input, wake-word listening, model connections and desktop workflows. The repository is based on MARK XLVIII by FatihMakes.
contributions: Set up and tested voice input and wake-word listening on my Windows environment.
Explored model connections, local AI tools and persistent project memory.
Worked through the practical integration and troubleshooting needed to use an assistant day to day.
note: Built on MARK XLVIII by FatihMakes. The upstream assistant architecture is credited to its original author; this is presented as personal integration work.

name: KZEL Operations
label: MAKING A COMPLEX WORKFLOW FEEL CLEAR
description: A visual workspace for markets, leads and AI agent activity. A product interface designed around an export founder’s day.
overview: The KZEL-CRM repository contains a KZEL OS interface prototype. It organizes specialized agent workspaces, market information, leads, campaigns and tasks into a single visual environment.
contributions: Organized the experience around company functions such as research, buyer discovery and outreach.
Integrated an interface with agent workspaces, navigation and activity views.
Explored how execution state and view state can stay separate while a user moves between workspaces.
note: The repository README identifies this milestone as a visual prototype. Agent events are simulated; provider connections and live execution are future integration work.
